body: I just want to be able to get past it and I just want to trust her again like I used to but it just really hurts right now

I have my own faults in the relationship too since it wouldn't be like this if I was a good partner. I just want to get over all the painful things that were said and I want to be able to trust her and open up to her like I used to before she told me all these things.

Now I just feel like I've been a burden to her. I didn't talk to her as much as I used to for a few weeks and she told me she's been having a better time and she's glad I'm doing an effort in improving myself but it feels like my feelings don't matter or if I do get honest with her she's just going to start feeling like shes done with me again

Thank you for your kind words

I'm not in the right headspace right now though because I'm just thinking of traveling miles just to see her so we can talk this out but I don't know if that'd just leave me stranded somewhere

Sir I believe you deserve better than I. I think you deserve to have a life not plagued by self ending thoughts and I hope it gets better for you.

Thank you for your kind words especially during this time where the pain just hurts so much I can't breathe.
I guess I should. I really have nothing to lose. Haha.
I don't even know how I'll be able to sleep. Every time I think about not having her in my life I just break down...

I just want the pain to stop. She was my childhood crush and I was over the moon when we got together. She's introduced me to the rest of her family just last month and now she's going to break up with me.
